collections.title: Essays
collections.synopsis: Essays on love, loss, money, parenting, technology and work, each noticing the small thing that turns out to be the big thing.

collections.title: Sunday Odds
collections.synopsis: A fiction series about money. Each Sunday, in her mother's kitchen in Fairfax, Virginia, Anika brings a question about her first real paycheck, and Revathi, who has worked in markets for twenty-six years, answers in odds instead of certainties.
collections.intro: Every Sunday, Anika drives to her mother's kitchen with a question she can't get a straight answer to online. Revathi sketches the numbers on a napkin, disagrees with her, and ends with one Monday Move. Money, here, is a set of odds, not a set of rules.
collections.read_note: New chapters on Sundays. Best read in order.
collections.disclaimer: Sunday Odds is a fiction series about money. Revathi and Anika are fictional, and the figures are illustrative. This is education, not personalized financial, tax or legal advice.

collections.title: Life is Happenning
collections.synopsis: A practical, funny, and occasionally enlightening guide to actually showing up for your own life.

collections.title: Pocket Poems
collections.synopsis: Short, plainspoken poems about love, longing, loss, and memory, and the quiet work of seeing yourself and the people you’ve lost without disguise.
